title: PappyJoe: Healthcare Management System
description:
PappyJoe is an India-based healthcare technology company that provides a cloud-based practice management platform for clinics, hospitals, and healthcare professionals. The platform helps manage appointments, electronic medical records (EMR), billing, prescriptions, patient communication, and administrative tasks in one system.

Price: $3 000 | Size: 413 GB | Records: 6 873 180 patients pii + 531 673 files | Dump date: 2026
